Description.SourceString:
We've all heard of it. We've all wanted it... the Legendary Abyssal Whip! The fabled weapon that heroes and adventurers have been seeking for an age!

You have taken it one step further. You have asked the question, "How hard could it be to make your own?". All you need is a spine from an Abyssal Demon! It comes pre-segmented and it's made from some of the hardiest organic material known to mortalkind. You just need to kill the demon, twist the shoulder, sever a tendon, and lo - your very own Abyssal Whip... right? Wrong.

Turns out, it's a bit more involved than you expected, and this "weapon" demonstrates that all too well.

Still, not all is lost. Perhaps there is a way, a method, to turn this... "thing" into something that lives up to it's legend.
